case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to alloy and material costs as the reason for your price, and we take that seriously. On those two lines the picture has moved the other way recently:

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since price changes can need sign-off on your side, could you take Option A to the person who decides and let us know?

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would like this to be a fair solution for both family companies, and we are grateful for your open and friendly approach so far.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices you cited, and we have adjusted our offer to reflect these market movements. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our internal cost structures are confidential and cannot be shared.

We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material volatility. Our current Angebot is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.40 per unit. This option features a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause to manage the alloy risk over a longer term. The price is fixed for that whole period, so neither side has to reopen it.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.90; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this goes beyond your own pricing authority, please take Option A to the colleague who decides on it.

We want a fair solution for both companies, and we are ready to close on this basis.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We can offer €5.30 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45 days payment, provided the index clause is included. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. As another alternative, we can offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
